pages.title: TILT
pages.creator: ApriCate Studio
pages.description: TILT combines pachinko drops with roguelite upgrades. Aim a ball through pegs that award chips and multipliers, then try to beat the round target within five balls. Spend coins on special pegs and charms that alter later drops.

pages.title: Strike Bullet
pages.creator: Yenemy Studios
pages.description: Strike Bullet challenges you to eliminate enemies with carefully aimed ricochets. Bounce your bullet off metal surfaces to reach targets outside a direct line of fire. Study the angles and trajectory as you work through twenty shooting-puzzle stages.

pages.title: Ciallo World
pages.creator: CialloLive
pages.description: Ciallo World mixes poker hands with roguelike character upgrades. Choose up to five cards from a draw of eight and reach each round's scoring target with limited plays and discards. Recruit programming-language characters whose skills combine into stronger scoring effects.

pages.title: Sweet Match
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Sweet Match asks you to release unblocked treats into a basket where identical pairs disappear. Choose the order carefully, since some sweets prevent others from falling. Clear the board by making useful pairs without filling the basket with unmatched treats.

pages.title: World Soccer
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: World Soccer turns a football match into a physics contest between movable pieces. Pull back one of your four objects and release it to strike the ball or another piece. Push the ball into the opposing net before your rival scores.

pages.title: Gothic Knife
pages.creator: PixelRaccoon
pages.description: Gothic Knife has you throw knives into a spinning target without striking existing blades or obstacles. Watch for changes in rotation and time each launch into an empty gap. Face a boss every third stage and build combos for higher scores.

pages.title: Super Hero Tycoon
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Super Hero Tycoon lets you build an income-producing base around a chosen superhero theme. Buy droppers and upgrades, collect cash, and open additional equipment. Expand the base while preparing powerful gear for player-versus-player battles with other heroes.

pages.title: Merge Fantasy
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Merge Fantasy gives you an island where trees, rocks, ore, and crystals provide resources. Combine at least three identical items to create upgraded objects and develop the land. Deliver finished creations to the deposit building for more resources, with dragons accompanying the journey.

pages.title: Tile Match: The Immersive Puzzle
pages.creator: HyperVedaGames
pages.description: Tile Match: The Immersive Puzzle challenges you to clear tiles by grouping three identical designs. Choose the order of your selections carefully so the board does not fill with unmatched pieces. Remove complete sets and work through each tile arrangement.

pages.title: SnakeMaxx
pages.creator: PT Arena Solusi Digital
pages.description: SnakeMaxx lets you guide a snake through fast-moving runs or player-versus-player contests. Steer with a mouse movement or finger drag as you navigate the action. Unlock character avatars, snake skins, and boosters to change your setup between attempts.

pages.title: Tricky Shots
pages.creator: GamesByJ
pages.description: Tricky Shots gives you a marble to aim with a pull-back shooting control. Select the marble, drag to set the shot's power and direction, and release to launch it. Adjust the strength of your next attempt while trying to improve the shot.

pages.title: Cat Life Simulator
pages.creator: CyberGoldfinch
pages.description: Cat Life Simulator lets you explore an open world, hunt, and take quests from animals and people. Improve your cat's skills, gather food, and furnish its home. Grow a family and help raise stronger kittens as you continue life in the world.

pages.title: 100 Doors Challenge
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: 100 Doors Challenge presents rooms that can only be left by opening their doors. Search for concealed objects and solve the surrounding puzzles to unlock the way forward. Each new room brings another combination of clues and interactions needed to continue.

pages.title: Neko's Adventure
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Neko's Adventure follows a cat crossing twenty platforming stages to rescue his girlfriend. Jump through the levels, face unusual enemies, and unlock a Power Beam that shoots fire. Use the new attack while working toward the end of the rescue journey.

pages.title: Force Master 3D
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Force Master 3D is a combat puzzle built around comparing power levels. Attack monsters with a lower value than yours to increase your own level. Choose the order of your battles carefully so you build enough strength for the enemies ahead.

pages.title: Two Dots Remastered
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Two Dots Remastered asks you to connect neighboring dots of the same color. Draw paths through horizontal or vertical neighbors, leaving diagonal connections out. Clear the linked dots for points and seek longer chains to improve the score from each move.

pages.title: Toilet Pin
pages.creator: Gamee JSC
pages.description: Toilet Pin challenges you to help a boy reach a toilet or recover toilet paper. Pull pins in the correct sequence to release rocks, fire, or ice against hostile letter monsters. Collect coins along the way to buy additional items.

pages.title: Hero Wizard: Save Your Girlfriend
pages.creator: ravel
pages.description: Hero Wizard: Save Your Girlfriend sends a spell-casting hero into a magic forest after receiving a rescue demand. Move through the dangerous setting and fight with ordinary or charged magic. Use the available power and healing controls while searching for the captive girlfriend.

pages.title: Basketball Fever
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Basketball Fever uses a one-touch flick to send basketballs toward the hoop. Judge the motion of each throw and try to keep the baskets coming. The shooting challenges become harder as you build a score in the stadium setting.

pages.title: Idle Mole Empire
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Idle Mole Empire has you develop an underground business with farms, gyms, laboratories, and other tunnels. Direct mole workers and elevators to move goods toward the sales office. Expand the operation and turn its production into cash for further development.

pages.title: Hawaii Match 4
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Hawaii Match 4 takes you through island-themed match-three puzzles featuring flowers and exotic fruit. Combine larger groups to generate stronger power-ups and tackle stage objectives. Continue through thousands of levels, with daily and weekly challenges providing additional tasks.

pages.title: Basket Shot Master
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Basket Shot Master has you move a basketball and release it to shoot toward the hoop. Compete with computer opponents who are trying to score as well. Hit a rival to interrupt their throw while creating an opening for your own basket.

pages.title: House Jam
pages.creator: tiplay studio
pages.description: House Jam challenges you to remove a red box from a room crowded with other boxes. Slide the surrounding pieces in their permitted directions to open an exit route. Find a solution within the move allowance rather than shifting boxes without a plan.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Soccer 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Soccer 2 brings colored-ball matching into a football stadium. Aim a ball at matching colors to make groups disappear and earn points. Look for shots that remove several balls together as you work through the arrangement on the pitch.

pages.title: Erase One Element
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Erase One Element presents visual riddles solved by removing part of a picture. Study the situation and swipe the eraser over the detail hiding the answer. Reveal the correct change to resolve problems involving concealed characters, danger, and everyday objects.

pages.title: Gun Shot
pages.creator: Gamebol
pages.description: Gun Shot is a target-shooting game with four different weapons to try. Aim at the targets and fire using the mouse to test your accuracy. Switch among the available guns as you work toward hitting every target in the challenge.

pages.title: Coin Dozer
pages.creator: Amazing Game
pages.description: Coin Dozer asks you to drop coins onto a crowded pushing platform. Time the drops so existing medals and prizes slide over the rewarding edges. Build your score, pursue quests, and use upgrades or power-ups to improve what you collect.

pages.title: Rope Bawling 3
pages.creator: Gamealliz
pages.description: Rope Bawling 3 turns bowling into a rope-cutting physics puzzle. Release suspended balls to knock down pins while accounting for lasers, spikes, chains, and airflow. Some obstacles require a laser or special fireball, so choose how to clear the route first.

pages.title: Freaky Monster Rush
pages.creator: PL Studio
pages.description: Freaky Monster Rush has you build a monster while running through an obstacle course. Pass through the appropriate gates to transform different body parts, knock enemies away, and dodge barrels. Your route choices determine the creature assembled during the race.

pages.title: Basketball King
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Basketball King challenges you to make baskets with swipe-controlled throws. Adjust each motion to direct the ball toward the hoop and work on consistent shooting. Try to beat existing records or compete with friends in the basketball scoring challenge.

pages.title: Stumble Boys Match
pages.creator: Mad Buffer
pages.description: Stumble Boys Match places you in an arena with other competitors across changing rounds. Run and jump through each event while meeting the round's survival requirement. Players who fall short are eliminated until a final contestant remains as the winner.

pages.title: Wordscapes
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Wordscapes asks you to connect supplied letters into the hidden words for each level. Try different letter sequences to discover the complete set of answers. Finishing a stage earns coins and opens the next collection of words to uncover.

pages.title: Fill In the holes
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Fill In the holes gives you numbered clues for coloring areas of a grid. Extend each number's color into exactly the required quantity of cells. Work out how the neighboring groups can fit together while meeting every numbered region's size requirement.

pages.title: Super Sort
pages.creator: Game Worthy Studios Inc.
pages.description: Super Sort combines organizing colored beads with making fused artwork. Use tweezers to move the beads into their matching cups, then apply an iron once sorting is finished. Add the completed bead pictures to your collection as you create more designs.

pages.title: Harvest Honors
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Harvest Honors is a multiplayer matching contest on a farm. Form groups of three or more items while trying to collect more carrots than your opponent. Search the board for useful matches and work toward winning the harvest competition.

pages.title: Funny Kitty Dressup
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Funny Kitty Dressup lets you create outfits for a cat using clothing, hats, shoes, and other accessories. Mix the pieces into costumes and help the kitty find additional looks. Play the accompanying minigames between visits to the feline wardrobe.

pages.title: Idle Arks: Sail and Build
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Idle Arks: Sail and Build gives you the task of constructing an ark from gathered wood. Collect enough raw material and recruit helpers to support the building effort. Expand the vessel and continue exploring to discover where the growing ark leads.

pages.title: Butterfly Kyodai Deluxe
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Butterfly Kyodai Deluxe challenges you to connect matching butterflies before the countdown ends. Clear pairs to complete the board and collect coins for new backgrounds. Hints and time-freezing help can provide breathing room when the remaining connections are difficult to spot.

pages.title: Brave Warriors
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Brave Warriors sends you across a dangerous valley in a side-scrolling platform adventure. Move through each stage, attack enemies, and overcome the challenges along the route. Search for every star before completing a level to finish its collection objective.

pages.title: Snowman Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Snowman Slide offers sliding puzzles based on three Christmas snowman pictures. Choose a grid of nine, sixteen, or twenty-five pieces and rearrange its sections. Restore the image by moving the tiles until the snowman's features line up correctly.

pages.title: Elevated Train Driving Simulator Sky Tram Driver
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Elevated Train Driving Simulator Sky Tram Driver puts you on rail tracks above a city's road traffic. Drive a futuristic train between stops and transport passengers along the elevated network. Guide the tram through its route while viewing the city from overhead.

pages.title: Impossible Line
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Impossible Line mixes jumping challenges with coin collection across obstacle-filled platforms. Click to jump and time the movement to reach the next surface safely. Retry a stage as often as needed while learning how to pass its difficult sections.

pages.title: Underwater Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Underwater Bubble Shooter challenges you to release fish held inside bubble cages. Aim and shoot to create groups of at least three bubbles sharing a color. Remove the bubbles surrounding the trapped fish so they can escape their underwater confinement.

pages.title: Cap Boy Run
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Cap Boy Run is an automatic side-scrolling chase in which a boy tries to save his sister. Time jumps to avoid enemies and keep him moving down the route. Collect jewels along the way to add points to the run.

pages.title: Ice Cream Decoration
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Ice Cream Decoration lets you assemble a frozen dessert from flavors, ingredients, and fruit. Choose what goes into the ice cream and add the finishing decorations. Once your design is complete, finish the activity by eating the treat you created.

pages.title: Pixel Dino Run
pages.creator: PowerSlash Studios
pages.description: Pixel Dino Run has you keep a dinosaur moving past obstacles through timed jumps. Tap to leap, then tap again while airborne to drop quickly. The dinosaur accelerates as your score increases, leaving less time to judge each landing.

pages.title: City Ambulance Simulator 2019
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: City Ambulance Simulator 2019 gives you emergency-driving duties helping injured people around the city. Follow the rescue missions and drive an ambulance toward those needing assistance. Try different ambulance models and camera views while handling the vehicle through the streets.

pages.title: Princess Cool Graffiti
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Princess Cool Graffiti joins Jacqueline for a session of street-art design and styling. Help turn plain walls into colorful graffiti using the available drawing options. Dress the princess in a street-artist look to accompany the artwork she creates.

pages.title: Desert car
pages.creator: Nicolas Tacgorian
pages.description: Desert car mixes driving with jumping and missile shooting across a long desert route. Start with three lives and react quickly as the course continues. Jump the car when needed and fire its launcher to handle the action ahead.

pages.title: Eagle Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Eagle Slide gives you three eagle pictures to restore through sliding-tile puzzles. Select one of the images and a mode, then move its sections into place. Match the bird's features across neighboring tiles until the original picture is complete.

pages.title: Volley Beans 3D
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Volley Beans 3D turns volleyball into a jumping duel controlled by a single input. Time your leaps to bounce and smash the ball toward the opponent's side. Keep reacting to its movement while trying to win the rally with well-timed strikes.

pages.title: Crazy Jelly Shift
pages.creator: AlienplayGames
pages.description: Crazy Jelly Shift challenges you to reshape a moving jelly figure to fit past obstacles. Drag to change its proportions as each opening approaches. Keep adjusting the shape correctly so it passes through the course and reaches a higher level.

pages.title: Monster Truck Dirt Racer
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Monster Truck Dirt Racer offers three modes of truck driving across multiple levels. Steer a monster truck through its dirt-racing challenges and switch the camera to change your view. Choose among the available vehicle skins as you continue through the driving stages.

pages.title: Elf Splash
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Elf Splash asks you to connect neighboring elves of the same type. Form chains of at least two matching characters to meet the current stage's target. Plan the connections carefully, since each level limits the moves available to finish its objective.

pages.title: Mr.Bullet
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Mr.Bullet challenges you to defend the city with carefully aimed gunfire. Point the weapon at enemies and fire to eliminate them, using the aiming line to judge a shot. Clear the opposing figures to complete the current combat puzzle.

pages.title: Paper Flight
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Paper Flight lets you launch a paper airplane and follow its journey through different places. Gather lucky stars during the flight and use them to improve the plane. Keep refining the aircraft as you attempt throws that carry it farther.

pages.title: Words Cracker
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Words Cracker asks you to slide columns of letters upward or downward to spell words across the center row. Letters turn green when used in a recognized word. Keep finding combinations until every required letter has been marked green.

pages.title: Garden Crush
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Garden Crush is a match-three puzzle built around vegetables. Arrange at least three matching crops in a line to remove them and earn points. Larger combinations produce special pieces and higher scores, giving you more ways to clear the field.

pages.title: Candy Mania
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Candy Mania has you slide sweets into groups of three adjacent matches. Remove the candies needed for the level's task while watching the countdown. Complete the objective before time expires by choosing matches that make progress across the board.

pages.title: Megacity Hop
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Megacity Hop challenges you to cross busy roads in an endless city. Hop forward and move sideways to find routes through traffic without getting hit. Gather coins during the crossing and spend them in the shop to unlock additional characters.

pages.title: Don't Spoil It!
pages.creator: JoyBits
pages.description: Don't Spoil It! is a collapsing-block puzzle where black blots threaten the board. Tap matching groups of colored blocks to remove them and push the dark marks away. Keep making useful clears so the spreading blots do not take over.

pages.title: Makeup for a Star
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Makeup for a Star asks you to prepare a princess for her rock concert. Choose cosmetics and create a glam-rock makeup look for the performance. Combine the available colors and facial styling choices to get the singer ready before she takes the stage.

pages.title: Prince & Princess Kiss Quest
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Prince & Princess Kiss Quest sends a prince climbing a castle tower to reach a demanding princess. Collect bonuses and presents along the ascent while avoiding incoming projectiles. Arrive with an elegant appearance and gifts to improve his chances of winning her affection.

pages.title: Fancy Cars Memory Match
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Fancy Cars Memory Match hides vehicle pictures behind a board of tiles. Select a level mode and turn cards over to locate matching cars. Remember the images revealed by earlier moves and clear every pair to complete the chosen memory challenge.

pages.title: Toilet Princess
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Toilet Princess puts you to work helping a spoiled princess clean a toilet. Follow the available cleaning interactions and deal with the mess in the bathroom. Complete the chores shown by the game to finish the princess's unexpected housekeeping task.

pages.title: Bubble Chicky
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Bubble Chicky follows a mother hen trying to reach chicks hidden behind vegetables. Use tomatoes and other available tools, including fireworks, to smash the obstructions. Work through the puzzle arrangements and clear a way for the determined hen to rescue her brood.

pages.title: Bubble Penguins
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Bubble Penguins puts a bubble cannon under your control in a colored-ball shooting puzzle. Aim at matching colors to clear groups and build your score. Special bubble types, including bombs and frozen pieces, change the choices available as the board develops.

pages.title: Renew Royal Couples Wardrobe
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Renew Royal Couples Wardrobe lets you browse clothing for royal partners and put together refreshed outfits. Move through the shop's item pages and select pieces for each character. Combine your choices into new looks for the couples in the styling session.

pages.title: Mall Shopping Sales
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Mall Shopping Sales takes a group of best friends through a discounted-clothing shopping session. Choose items that suit each girl's style and combine skirts or trousers with matching pieces. Build complete outfits as you explore the fashion choices in the sale selection.

pages.title: Sery Prom Dolly Dress Up H5
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Sery Prom Dolly Dress Up H5 has you open mystery boxes to discover Sery's prom wardrobe. Try dresses, footwear, bags, and accessories in different combinations. Finish a coordinated outfit and save a picture of the look for her album before prom.
